title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.
